requirement_text: System shall validate the information provided by the user using JavaScript on the client side.
user_story: As a user, I want the information I provide to be validated in my browser with JavaScript, so that mistakes are caught before submission.
technical_task: Add JavaScript checks that run on the client side to validate user-entered information.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user enters invalid information, when the user submits the form, then JavaScript validation reports the problem on the client side.
Given a user enters valid information, when the user submits the form, then the information passes the client-side validation.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which fields are validated is not stated.

requirement_text: Users can view, update, or delete their own profile.
user_story: As a registered user, I want to view, update or delete my own profile, so that I control my information.
technical_task: Offer view, update and delete actions on the signed-in user's own profile.
acceptance_criteria: Given a signed-in user, when the user opens their profile, then the profile is shown with options to update and delete it.
Given a signed-in user, when the user tries to open another user's profile for editing, then the action is not allowed.
rationale: Role assumed: registered user. "Own" implies the second criterion.

requirement_text: The solution should provide audit capabilities indicating the time stamp for an object or data modification in accordance with users' scope or practice organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should provide audit capabilities indicating the time stamp for an object or data modification in accordance with users' scope or practice  organizational policy  or jurisdictional law.
user_story: As a compliance officer, I want audit capabilities that show a time stamp for each modification of an object or data, so that changes can be traced under the applicable policy or law.
technical_task: Record a time stamp whenever an object or data is modified, following the user's scope of practice, organizational policy or jurisdictional law.
acceptance_criteria: Given an object or data is modified, when the change is saved, then an audit record with a time stamp is created.
Given the audit records, when a reviewer opens them, then the time stamp of each modification can be seen.
rationale: Role assumed: compliance officer. Which policy or law applies is not specified.

requirement_text: The LHCP can view of the comprehensive patient report for the specified group including the information below.
requirement_text_raw: The LHCP can view of the comprehensive patient report for the specified group  including the information below.
user_story: As an LHCP, I want to view the comprehensive patient report for a specified group including the listed information, so that I can review the group as a whole.
technical_task: Generate a comprehensive patient report for a specified group of patients that includes the listed information items.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specified group of patients, when the LHCP requests the comprehensive patient report, then the report is shown.
Given the report, when the LHCP reads it, then it includes the information items listed for the report.
rationale: Role stated: LHCP. The list of information items is not included in the sentence.

requirement_text: The system shall allow to Submit applications with information, plans, and documents.
user_story: As an applicant, I want to submit an application with information, plans and documents, so that it can be reviewed.
technical_task: Build an application submission that accepts information, plans and documents together.
acceptance_criteria: Given an application form, when the applicant adds information, plans and documents and submits, then the application is submitted with all of them.
Given an application missing required content, when the applicant submits it, then the applicant is told what is missing.
rationale: Role assumed: applicant. Which items are mandatory is not stated; the second criterion is an assumption.

requirement_text: It is feasible to allocate objects not to the ego lane with collision overlap during small curve radii to avoid potentially implausible functional reactions, i.
rationale: The sentence is cut off and does not say what behaviour is required.
clarification_questions: What is meant by "implausible functional reactions"?
What is the complete text of the sentence, which ends with "i."?

requirement_text: The FCP shall wait up to 2.5 seconds (from the sending of the FCP Ready Sync) for the ICP Ready signal. Note that FTSS will not fail the FCR if this signal is not received within this time. FTSS will wait until the normal ICP presence test fails.
requirement_text_raw: The FCP shall [SRS189] wait up to 2.5 seconds (from the sending of the FCP Ready Sync) for the ICP Ready signal.  Note that FTSS will not fail the FCR if this signal is not received within this time.  FTSS will wait until the normal ICP presence test fails.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FCP to wait up to 2.5 seconds after sending the FCP Ready Sync for the ICP Ready signal, so that a late signal is still accepted.
technical_task: Set the FCP to wait up to 2.5 seconds from the sending of the FCP Ready Sync for the ICP Ready signal, and have FTSS keep waiting until the normal ICP presence test fails instead of failing the FCR.
acceptance_criteria: Given the FCP has sent the FCP Ready Sync, when the ICP Ready signal arrives within 2.5 seconds, then the FCP accepts it.
Given the ICP Ready signal is not received within 2.5 seconds, when the time passes, then FTSS does not fail the FCR and waits until the normal ICP presence test fails.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: System shall display all available cars with hourly and per kilometer charges.
user_story: As a renter, I want to see all available cars with their hourly and per kilometer charges, so that I can compare prices.
technical_task: List every available car together with its hourly charge and its per kilometer charge.
acceptance_criteria: Given available cars, when the renter opens the car list, then each available car is shown.
Given a listed car, when the renter views it, then its hourly and per kilometer charges are displayed.
rationale: Role assumed: renter.

requirement_text: The solution should appropriately label information in storage in process and in transmission.
requirement_text_raw: The solution should appropriately label information in storage  in process  and in transmission.
user_story: As a security officer, I want information to be labeled whether it is in storage, in process or in transmission, so that it is handled according to its label.
technical_task: Apply labels to information that is stored, in process or in transmission.
acceptance_criteria: Given information in storage, when it is held by the solution, then it carries a label.
Given information in process or in transmission, when it is handled, then it carries a label.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer. What "appropriately" means for the label is not defined.

requirement_text: The solution should leverage CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure for sending files external to CCHCS data center.
user_story: As a data custodian, I want files sent outside the CCHCS data center to go through the CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure, so that transfers are secure.
technical_task: Route outbound files for destinations external to the CCHCS data center through the existing CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure.
acceptance_criteria: Given a file to be sent outside the CCHCS data center, when it is sent, then it goes through the CCHCS Secure FTP infrastructure.
Given a file for an internal destination, when it is sent, then the requirement does not apply.
rationale: Role assumed: data custodian.

requirement_text: System shall provide meaningful error messages when dataset creation or reconfiguration fails due to incompatible properties.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want meaningful error messages when dataset creation or reconfiguration fails because of incompatible properties, so that I can fix the settings.
technical_task: Show an error message that names the problem when dataset creation or reconfiguration fails due to incompatible properties.
acceptance_criteria: Given incompatible properties, when dataset creation fails, then an error message explains the problem.
Given incompatible properties, when dataset reconfiguration fails, then an error message explains the problem.
rationale: Role assumed: data analyst. "Meaningful" is read as naming the cause.

requirement_text: If the timer is running and the hood open M:Hood open, execution of the function is to be ended and can be restarted by closing the hood.
user_story: As a machine operator, I want the function to end when the hood is open while the timer is running and to restart when the hood is closed, so that the machine stops safely.
technical_task: End the running function when the hood opens (M:Hood open) and allow it to be restarted by closing the hood.
acceptance_criteria: Given the timer is running, when the hood is opened, then execution of the function ends.
Given the function has ended because the hood was opened, when the hood is closed, then the function can be restarted.
rationale: Role assumed: machine operator.

requirement_text: The user could erase all the statistics.
user_story: As a user, I want to erase all the statistics, so that I can start fresh.
technical_task: Offer a function that deletes all stored statistics.
acceptance_criteria: Given stored statistics, when the user chooses to erase them, then all statistics are erased.
Given statistics have been erased, when the user opens the statistics, then none are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: user. "Could" is read as a capability the user has.

requirement_text: System's reliability depends on continuous backup of the database.
rationale: The sentence states a dependency instead of a requirement and gives no target.
clarification_questions: Is the requirement that the database backup must run continuously?

requirement_text: The solution de-identification capability should include: FAX numbers.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want the de-identification capability to include FAX numbers, so that they are removed from shared data.
technical_task: Add FAX numbers to the identifiers handled by the de-identification capability.
acceptance_criteria: Given data containing a FAX number, when it is de-identified, then the FAX number is removed.
Given de-identified data, when it is reviewed, then no FAX number remains.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. "Include" is read as including FAX numbers among identifiers to remove.

requirement_text: User shall follow exact sequencing of operations for system tasks.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want users to follow an exact sequence of operations for system tasks, so that tasks are done correctly.
technical_task: Enforce a fixed order of steps for system tasks.
acceptance_criteria: Given a system task, when the user performs the steps in the required order, then the task completes.
Given a system task, when the user performs a step out of order, then the system does not allow it.
rationale: Role assumed: system administrator. The sequences are not listed.

requirement_text: He or she can report the height weight possibly and possibly pedometer reading for the patient.
requirement_text_raw: He or she can report the height  weight  possibly and possibly pedometer reading  for the patient.
user_story: As a patient, I want to report my height, weight and possibly pedometer reading, so that my record is complete.
technical_task: Let a patient or representative enter height, weight and optionally a pedometer reading.
acceptance_criteria: Given a patient record, when the user enters height and weight, then the values are saved.
Given a patient record, when the user enters a pedometer reading, then the reading is saved.
rationale: Role assumed: patient; the sentence says "he or she".

requirement_text: The system shall allow authorized users to delete sub-apps and their launchers within the main application.
user_story: As an authorized user, I want to delete sub-apps and their launchers in the main application, so that unused ones are removed.
technical_task: Support removal of a sub-app together with its launcher, restricted to authorized users.
acceptance_criteria: Given an authorized user, when the user deletes a sub-app, then the sub-app and its launcher are removed from the main application.
Given a user who is not authorized, when the user tries to delete a sub-app, then it is not deleted.
rationale: Role stated: authorized user.

requirement_text: These additional non-functional requirements aim to further enhance the performance, security, user experience, reliability, and availability of the system.
rationale: The sentence describes the aim of other requirements and states none itself.
clarification_questions: Which non-functional requirements does "these additional" point to?
What measurable targets are meant for performance, security, reliability and availability?

requirement_text: Process scheduling shall only be performed at certain controlled locations (synchronization points).
requirement_text_raw: Process scheduling shall (3.3.4.4) only be performed at certain controlled locations (synchronization points).
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want process scheduling to happen only at controlled synchronization points, so that scheduling is predictable.
technical_task: Restrict process scheduling to specific controlled locations known as synchronization points.
acceptance_criteria: Given a process to be scheduled, when scheduling occurs, then it takes place at a synchronization point.
Given no synchronization point is reached, when time passes, then no process scheduling is performed.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: User shall test the functionality of a Neurohub installation with a script.
user_story: As an administrator, I want to test a Neurohub installation with a script, so that I can confirm it works.
technical_task: Provide a test script that exercises the functionality of a Neurohub installation.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Neurohub installation, when the test script is run, then the functionality is tested.
Given the script finishes, when the administrator reads the output, then the outcome of the tests is shown.
rationale: Role assumed: administrator.

requirement_text: 7.For the NEFU, if errors are identified after the processor has been masked out, and if at least 4 NEs are still active, the NE shall be removed from the configuration and recovery will be attempted. Note that the NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.
requirement_text_raw: 7.For the NEFU, if errors are identified after the processor has been masked out, and if at least 4 NEs are still active, the NE shall [SRS283] be removed from the configuration and recovery will be attempted.  Note that the NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want an NE on the NEFU removed from the configuration and recovery attempted when errors are found after the processor is masked out and at least 4 NEs are still active, so that the system keeps running.
technical_task: After the processor is masked out on the NEFU, remove the NE from the configuration and attempt recovery if errors are identified and at least 4 NEs are still active, regardless of whether alignment is permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given errors are identified on the NEFU after the processor is masked out and at least 4 NEs are active, when the check runs, then the NE is removed from the configuration and recovery is attempted.
Given the NEFU recovery, when alignment is not permitted, then recovery is still attempted.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.

requirement_text: The solution should authenticate principals prior to accessing an EMR application or EMR data.
user_story: As a clinician, I want principals to be authenticated before they access an EMR application or EMR data, so that only identified users get in.
technical_task: Require authentication of the principal before access to an EMR application or EMR data is granted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a principal who has authenticated, when the principal opens an EMR application, then access is granted.
Given a principal who has not authenticated, when the principal requests EMR data, then access is not granted.
rationale: Role assumed: clinician.

requirement_text: System shall provide an intuitive blog creation interface for administrators.
rationale: "Intuitive" is subjective and not measurable.
clarification_questions: What makes a blog creation interface "intuitive"?
How will intuitiveness be measured for administrators?

requirement_text: The solution should provide the ability to generate an audit report.
user_story: As an auditor, I want to generate an audit report, so that I can review activity.
technical_task: Add an audit report generation function.
acceptance_criteria: Given recorded activity, when the user requests an audit report, then the report is generated.
Given the generated report, when it is opened, then it lists the audited activity.
rationale: Role assumed: auditor. The report contents are not described.

requirement_text: The system shall have a disaster recovery plan to ensure data integrity and system functionality in case of outages.
user_story: As a system owner, I want a disaster recovery plan, so that data integrity and system functionality are kept in case of outages.
technical_task: Write and maintain a disaster recovery plan for outages that protects data integrity and system functionality.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system documentation, when it is reviewed, then a disaster recovery plan exists.
Given an outage, when the plan is followed, then data integrity and system functionality are maintained.
rationale: Role assumed: system owner. The plan's contents are not specified.

requirement_text: (A) Electronic health information that is stored must be encrypted in accordance with the standard specified in § 170.210(a)(1).
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want stored electronic health information to be encrypted according to the standard in 170.210(a)(1), so that it is protected.
technical_task: Encrypt all stored electronic health information using the method required by the standard specified in 170.210(a)(1).
acceptance_criteria: Given electronic health information that is stored, when it is saved, then it is encrypted in accordance with 170.210(a)(1).
Given stored electronic health information, when it is read without the key, then it cannot be understood.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. The standard is only referenced; the section symbol in the source is garbled.

requirement_text: The system shall allow researchers to download files, reports, and locate materials for social media sharing.
user_story: As a researcher, I want to download files and reports and find materials to share on social media, so that I can spread my work.
technical_task: Offer file and report downloads and a way to locate materials for social media sharing.
acceptance_criteria: Given available files and reports, when a researcher selects one to download, then it is downloaded.
Given materials in the system, when a researcher looks for something to share, then the materials can be located for social media sharing.
rationale: Role stated: researcher.

requirement_text: The SELECT [by name] command is processed by the OPEN.
rationale: The sentence describes processing between undefined components without a clear requirement.
clarification_questions: What do SELECT [by name] and OPEN refer to?
What must the system do when the command is issued?

requirement_text: The MultiMahjongClient will have sound effects associated with the game actions.
user_story: As a player, I want sound effects for the game actions, so that the game feels more engaging.
technical_task: Add sound effects to the MultiMahjongClient that play on game actions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a game action in the MultiMahjongClient, when the action happens, then its associated sound effect plays.
Given several different game actions, when each happens, then each has an associated sound effect.
rationale: Role assumed: player. Which actions have which sounds is not stated.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall issue a voted reset to the failed channel, if alignment is permitted. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS204] issue a voted reset to the failed channel, if alignment is permitted. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to issue a voted reset to the failed channel if alignment is permitted, so that the channel is recovered.
technical_task: Issue a voted reset to the failed channel from Redundancy Management when alignment is permitted.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failed channel and alignment is permitted, when Redundancy Management handles the failure, then it issues a voted reset to the failed channel.
Given alignment is not permitted, when a channel fails, then no voted reset is required by this requirement.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The note about NEFU recovery is outside this behaviour.

requirement_text: System shall offer easy access to the blog for user consumption.
user_story: As a reader, I want easy access to the blog, so that I can read posts.
technical_task: Link the blog from a prominent place so users can open it directly.
acceptance_criteria: Given the main page, when a user looks for the blog, then a link to the blog is available.
Given the link, when a user selects it, then the blog opens.
rationale: Role assumed: reader. "Easy" is interpreted as a direct link.

requirement_text: Software is developed keeping downward compatibility intact.
user_story: As a customer, I want the software developed with downward compatibility intact, so that older setups keep working.
technical_task: Preserve downward compatibility in each new software release.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new software release, when it is used with data or setups from an earlier release, then it works.
Given a new software release, when compatibility is reviewed, then no downward compatibility is lost.
rationale: Role assumed: customer. Which earlier releases are covered is not stated.

requirement_text: User shall be able to sign up and validate credentials, leading to access to the Snap camera screen.
user_story: As a new user, I want to sign up and have my credentials validated, so that I can reach the Snap camera screen.
technical_task: Implement sign-up with credential validation that leads to the Snap camera screen.
acceptance_criteria: Given a new user, when the user signs up with valid credentials, then the credentials are validated and the Snap camera screen opens.
Given invalid credentials, when the user tries to sign up, then validation fails and the camera screen does not open.
rationale: Role assumed: new user.

requirement_text: The product shall implement caching mechanisms to optimize load times and reduce server requests.
user_story: As a user, I want pages to load quickly through caching, so that waiting is reduced and servers receive fewer requests.
technical_task: Introduce caching to shorten load times and cut down server requests.
acceptance_criteria: Given a resource requested before, when it is requested again, then it is served from the cache.
Given cached resources, when pages load, then fewer requests reach the server.
rationale: Role assumed: user. No target load time is given.

requirement_text: A Drexel University Web API is being designed to answer questions about campus facilities, staff, policies, dining, and food trucks, with accuracy ranging from 40% for food trucks to 80% for generic question construction.
user_story: As a student, I want a Web API to answer questions about campus facilities, staff, policies, dining and food trucks, so that I can find campus information.
technical_task: Develop a Drexel University Web API that answers questions on campus facilities, staff, policies, dining and food trucks, with accuracy ranging from 40% for food trucks to 80% for generic question construction.
acceptance_criteria: Given a question about food trucks, when the API answers, then its accuracy is about 40%.
Given a generically constructed question, when the API answers, then its accuracy is about 80%.
rationale: Role assumed: student. The accuracy figures describe the expected range.

requirement_text: System shall be able to perform distance calculations and access geolocation information for the user, sites, and nearby sites.
user_story: As a traveler, I want distance calculations and geolocation for me, sites and nearby sites, so that I can see what is close.
technical_task: Provide distance calculation and geolocation access for the user, sites and nearby sites.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user's location and a site, when a distance is requested, then the distance is calculated.
Given the user, when nearby sites are requested, then they are found using geolocation information.
rationale: Role assumed: traveler.

requirement_text: The product must be user-friendly, with 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators finding it easy to use.
user_story: As an insurance adjuster, I want the product to be user-friendly, with 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators finding it easy to use, so that I can work efficiently.
technical_task: Design the product to be user-friendly and confirm in a survey that 95% of Adjusters and Collision Estimators find it easy to use.
acceptance_criteria: Given a survey of Adjusters and Collision Estimators, when the results are counted, then 95% find the product easy to use.
Given fewer than 95% find the product easy to use, when the results are evaluated, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role stated: Adjusters and Collision Estimators. The survey method is not specified.

requirement_text: Details regarding management of error handling can be found in the DPRS.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the DPRS say about error handling?
Is the referenced content part of this requirement?

requirement_text: A UAP can select to report height or weight or pedometer measurements.
user_story: As a UAP, I want to select whether to report height, weight or pedometer measurements, so that I send only what I have.
technical_task: Allow a UAP to choose which of height, weight or pedometer measurements to report.
acceptance_criteria: Given a report form, when the UAP selects height, then a height measurement can be reported.
Given a report form, when the UAP selects weight or pedometer, then that measurement can be reported.
rationale: Role stated: UAP.

requirement_text: The flowing air test device shall create a flowing air region at least ten times larger than the test object (HF-MIC).
user_story: As a test engineer, I want the flowing air test device to create a flowing air region at least ten times larger than the test object (HF-MIC), so that the test object is fully covered.
technical_task: Build the flowing air test device so its flowing air region is at least ten times larger than the HF-MIC test object.
acceptance_criteria: Given the flowing air test device, when its flowing air region is measured, then it is at least ten times larger than the test object.
Given a region smaller than that size, when the device is checked, then it does not meet the requirement.
rationale: Role assumed: test engineer. "Larger" is not specified as length, area or volume.

requirement_text: The solution should prevent access to EMR applications or EMR data to all non-authenticated principals.
user_story: As a security officer, I want EMR applications and data to be blocked for all non-authenticated principals, so that only identified users get access.
technical_task: Deny every non-authenticated principal access to EMR applications and EMR data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a non-authenticated principal, when the principal opens an EMR application, then access is denied.
Given a non-authenticated principal, when the principal requests EMR data, then access is denied.
rationale: Role assumed: security officer.

requirement_text: The BE shall be able to signal a kill for any Backend process.
user_story: As a system operator, I want the BE to signal a kill for any Backend process, so that I can stop a process.
technical_task: Add a kill signal that the BE can send to any Backend process.
acceptance_criteria: Given a running Backend process, when the BE signals a kill, then the process is stopped.
Given any Backend process, when the BE signals a kill, then the signal can be sent to it.
rationale: Role assumed: system operator. BE and Backend are kept as written.

requirement_text: The thermal shock corresponds to the largest deviation of the differential curve (Kistler vs. CPS).
rationale: The sentence describes a physical quantity and gives no requirement.
clarification_questions: What does "largest deviation of the differential curve" mean in a requirement?

requirement_text: The system shall be capable of flagging and marking corrupted data segments and proceeding without interruption or effect on other data.
user_story: As a data analyst, I want corrupted data segments flagged and marked while processing continues, so that other data is unaffected.
technical_task: Detect corrupted data segments, flag and mark them, and continue processing without interruption or effect on other data.
acceptance_criteria: Given a corrupted data segment, when the system processes the data, then the segment is flagged and marked.
Given a corrupted data segment, when processing continues, then other data is processed without interruption or effect.
rationale: Role assumed: data analyst.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall provide to the telemetry program the FTPP telemetry data which consists of the following elements: a. FCP status, b. NE status, c. # Transient Errors, d. Transient recovery attempts, e. Frame overruns, f. ICP status.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall (3.4.2.2) provide to the telemetry program the FTPP telemetry data which consists of the following elements:  a. FCP status, b. NE status, c. # Transient Errors, d. Transient recovery attempts, e. Frame overruns, f. ICP status.
user_story: As a telemetry engineer, I want the FTSS software to give the telemetry program the FTPP telemetry data, so that I can monitor the system.
technical_task: Supply the telemetry program with FTPP telemetry data containing the FCP status, NE status, number of transient errors, transient recovery attempts, frame overruns and ICP status.
acceptance_criteria: Given the telemetry program, when it requests FTPP telemetry data, then the FTSS software provides it.
Given the provided data, when it is inspected, then it contains FCP status, NE status, transient errors, transient recovery attempts, frame overruns and ICP status.
rationale: Role assumed: telemetry engineer. The list items are taken from the requirement.

requirement_text: System shall implement advanced secure login algorithms to provide secure login to users.
rationale: "Advanced secure login algorithms" are not specified, so the requirement cannot be tested.
clarification_questions: Which algorithms or standards are required?

requirement_text: System shall track progress and updates of ongoing investigations.
user_story: As an investigator, I want to track the progress and updates of ongoing investigations, so that I know where each stands.
technical_task: Record and show the progress and updates of every ongoing investigation.
acceptance_criteria: Given an ongoing investigation, when its progress changes, then the update is recorded.
Given an ongoing investigation, when the user opens it, then its progress and updates are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: investigator.

requirement_text: The system shall record client booking requests.
user_story: As a staff member, I want client booking requests to be recorded, so that none is lost.
technical_task: Store each client booking request when it is received.
acceptance_criteria: Given a client booking request, when it is received, then it is recorded.
Given recorded requests, when staff open the list, then the booking requests are shown.
rationale: Role assumed: staff member.

requirement_text: The timestamps shall also be congruent across all active processors in the case of a broadcast.
requirement_text_raw: The timestamps shall (3.2.2.7.3) also be congruent across all active processors in the case of a broadcast.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want timestamps to be congruent across all active processors in a broadcast, so that all processors share the same time.
technical_task: Keep timestamps congruent on all active processors whenever a broadcast occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a broadcast, when it reaches all active processors, then the timestamps are congruent across them.
Given an active processor, when a broadcast is received, then its timestamp matches those of the other active processors.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer.
